subject.summary: One run of NetLogo's Fire at 61% density: the fire is lit along the left edge and spreads only from tree to neighbouring tree. Its front, every 26 ticks, is raised to its tick, so the burn climbs as it crosses the forest. Half of the burn is done by tick 220 and the front reaches the far edge at tick 392, but pockets it left behind smoulder on: the last tree catches at tick 664. In all, 76.8% of the trees burned.
